run_local_dns_server: run a local DNS server on a specified port using a YAML records config file
start_dns_server_with_records: start a DNS server that serves A, AAAA, SRV, and TXT records from a YAML config
add_extra_a_record: add a one-off A record to the DNS server via the --add_a_record CLI flag
test_dns_resolver_with_server: test DNS resolver behavior by running the local DNS server with custom record groups
review_NoFileAuthority_class: review the NoFileAuthority class that extends FileAuthority to serve in-memory DNS records
